text:
Ava (CSM): Heads up — final pass on the QBR slate tonight. Need slide owners, one-line exec asks, and any renewal risk updates. Can we lock by EOD?

Ravi (Solutions): I can take the "Integration wins" slide. Will add the two customer quotes and runtime numbers.

Elena (Eng): I’ll add perf numbers and the outage blips. Quick ask: which time range for latency? last 30d?

Ava (CSM): last 30d + change since last QBR — short note about mitigations.

Marcus (CS Ops): I’ll own the "Operational readiness" slide and the canary/fallback plan. Need the final SLA target from Eng.

Elena (Eng): SLA target is 99.9% p99 latency < 350ms for hosted API — I’ll paste a small chart into the slide.

Carmen (PM): I’ll write the exec one-liner for product direction. Draft: "Investing in serving reliability and cost-efficiency to scale integrations." Thoughts?

Marcus (CS Ops): Sounds good, Carmen. Shorten to "Prioritizing serving reliability and cost-efficiency." :thumbsup:

Ava (CSM): We have one renewal risk to flag — HorizonPay. Low usage on embeddings, exec is worried about ROI. Can Solutions propose a targeted enablement?

Ravi (Solutions): Yes — propose 2 workshops + template prompts, and a 30-day adoption pulse. Will add to action items.

Ava (CSM): Great. Add owner = Ravi, due = next Tue.

runbook-bot: Reminder: QBR runbook checklist updated — https://runbook.internal/qbr-templates

Ava (CSM): Folks — quick checklist (paste into slide deck):
```
- Slide owners locked
- Exec one-liner (1 sentence)
- Top 3 metrics (30d)
- Renewal risk highlight + mitigation owner
- Demo cue and backup plan
- Post-QBR action tracker link
```

Carmen (PM): I added demo cue and fallback note. Marcus — can you confirm backup infra path?

Marcus (CS Ops): Confirmed. Backup path = regional fallback + model-variant downgrade. I’ll add a 1-line note.

Elena (Eng): Dropping the perf snippet now. Also adding a short note on KV cache improvements.

Ravi (Solutions): For HorizonPay enablement, I’ll attach the workshop slides and a short adoption play.

Ava (CSM): Can we do an exec dry run tomorrow 9:30am PT? Need Marcus and Carmen to attend.

Marcus (CS Ops): Available.

Carmen (PM): Available.

Elena (Eng): I can join first 15 mins for the perf slide.

Ava (CSM): Perfect. Last ask — capture any customer feedback in the follow-up doc after QBR. Use this tracker: https://docs.internal/qbr-actions and tag with #horizonpay if relevant.

Ravi (Solutions): Will do.

Ava (CSM): Thanks everyone — locking owners and action items now. I’ll post final deck link in channel after the dry run. :rocket:
